findings.title: Stale ownership cache after session row change
findings.description: EventVisibilityIndex::session_admits caches SessionOwnership but has NO invalidation when sessions are mutated (delete, patch, restore).
findings.trigger: Any session row change followed by event within cache lifetime
findings.suggested_fix: Add invalidate(session_key) and invalidate_team(team_id) methods; wire from modify handlers

findings.title: handle_logs reads entire log file into memory unbounded
findings.description: tokio::fs::read_to_string reads WHOLE log with no size cap. params.lines accepts arbitrary usize up to usize::MAX. OOM DoS.
findings.trigger: Large log file or huge params.lines
findings.suggested_fix: Cap params.lines, bound file read by streaming tail

findings.title: Voice stream mint uses ambient_owner which is room creator in project rooms
findings.description: StreamRegistry::insert captures ambient_owner() = CALLER_USER → falls back to scope.owner_user_id (room creator in project rooms). Voice stream attributed to creator instead of member.
findings.trigger: Voice stream opened from tool context within project room
findings.suggested_fix: Use ambient_actor() (prefers room_author) or accept explicit author param

findings.title: Swallowed event_bus publish errors
findings.description: let _ = ctx.event_bus.publish_json(...) silently drops failures (node.connected, presence.joined, etc.)
findings.suggested_fix: Replace with if let Err tracing::warn!

findings.title: sessions.patch leaves ownership cache stale (sub-case of P1 #1)
findings.description: handle_patch_db mutates metadata without invalidating EventVisibilityIndex cache

findings.title: Unbounded subscription patterns per connection
findings.description: TopicFilter::add_subscription dedupes exact matches but no upper bound on distinct patterns
findings.trigger: Authenticated client submits many unique patterns

findings.title: note_frame cache misses on transient-row frames cause store-query storm
findings.description: Brand-new conversation where first frames arrive before session row is written
findings.suggested_fix: Documented and intentional; consider short-lived negative cache

findings.title: handle_logs returns Vec<String> over JSON-RPC, no byte-size cap
